text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. I understand the situation. In 
other words, Trainer, what you're trying 
to say is this.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...that I am beautiful!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is that how it is?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't. Simply because it was 
different. ...Did they really understand 
what I told them, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding. You just want to check if 
Acute-san's fatigue is from "hard 
training," right?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: So, what did the doctor say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we naturally had the doctor at 
Tracen Academy examine her as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The diagnosis was—"vague fatigue." "It is 
at least not an illness, but beyond that, 
we cannot say," was the doctor's 
assessment.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, I suppose that makes sense. 
If even the doctors can't figure it out—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (FLAP!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Dr. Supreme Ruler will investigate you 
personally! By running right beside you on 
the track!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaaaa, Opera O-chan with me? That's 
quite a big deal~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I can't really run on turf, you 
know? I'm no match for them at all...”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then dirt is fine by me. This Supreme King 
can shine anywhere—land, sea, or sky.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Young Werther may have his sorrows, but 
The Saddler has none. Though I'll 
certainly pass on Broadway's hard asphalt!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Uncertain of what she meant, T.M. Opera O 
stood gallantly on the track. The mock 
race to investigate the cause got 
underway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang! Thump thump thump thump thump)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(—!? Opera O looks like she's running so 
effortlessly, yet how is she going that 
fast?)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Somehow... I have to keep up somehow...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, that's some impressive dashing 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(On dirt, my specialty! I can push even 
further from here...!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hooooryaaah!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O, magnificent! Leaving the pumpkin 
carriage in the dust, the sorcerer gallops 
onward!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Have you forgotten, though? Your opponent 
is none other than this Supreme Overlord! 
Now, let us rendezvous to the castle!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Her opponent was a Seven-Crown Umamusume. 
Even on dirt, victory was out of reach.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, whew, phew...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing you this exhausted... The reason 
goes without saying, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because "I'm way too strong"! Take me on 
head-to-head, and of course it ends like 
this.
choice_data_list:
So... how did the hard training affect 
you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was what I wanted to know most of 
all. Fully aware that the opponent is 
strong—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason why Wonder Acute's body is 
screaming in protest. As expected, it 
is...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, from this Doctor Overlord's 
diagnosis, her body is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: In perfect health, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh dear me... Perfectly healthy...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Even though she's still in the 
Classic Class, the reason she could keep 
up with my running is because of her 
supple muscles.”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Enough to put professional dancers to 
shame. Whenever the mood strikes, feel 
free to join my troupe anytime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Was there any fallout from the hardcore 
training? Is there truly no need to worry 
about Wonder Acute's fatigue?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Um, well then, I guess I'll...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing to fret over! Train as 
you always have— no, train with even 
greater vigor than before!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I, the Overlord, shall prove that your 
body is in peak condition!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So they say, Trainer. Guess you were just 
fretting over nothing...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Looks like your training method was right 
on the mark, Trainer. Let's keep charging 
straight into the Japan Dirt Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O says so. Wonder Acute does, 
too. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Can I really believe in it? In my own way 
of doing things, truly?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's just... changing the routine every 
single training session makes me a bit 
anxious.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Even when I ask around, none of the other 
girls are doing such a one-sided 
routine...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I'm sorry. Could we actually call off 
the whole personal Trainer thing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The other Umamusume sensed the danger and 
turned down the scout offer. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is kind. That's why she 
accepted my way of doing things. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Won't that kindness end up breaking her? 
If she continues the wrong training all 
the way to the end...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I did that... I'd end up crushing the 
one and only Umamusume who believed in 
me..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list: I can't make it any harder than this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*pitter-patter-patter!*)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Aaah~, Trainer? Hellooo, Traaaiineer!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. To think you'd turn your 
back on me after I went through the 
trouble of advising you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh, you remind me of someone I know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Um, Opera O-chan? About the reason why I 
run out of breath sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Could this mean...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho, does something come to mind? However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have no interest in such things. I 
wouldn't spare a second glance for stage 
directions or prompts, after all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't you be telling that to someone 
other than me?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ugh... But...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. The clock's hands haven't 
pointed to the heavens just yet. We still 
have time."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"By the time of your goal, the Japan Dirt 
Derby, that is."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The "Japan Dirt Derby"...
